rationale: Final review turn. All five registered questions are explained with fixed-experiment receipts (core decided regression, decided-stream duplicate and fan-out skip, false append_notify Ok, sparse-pid trim, StopSign non-decision), plus two sourced protections (buffered proposals forwarded on AcceptSync, snapshot compaction independent of the minimum accepted index). Remaining candidates were checked against source and the supplied fault model and rejected as target defects: duplicate pids in ClusterConfig are caller-supplied invalid input that validate() does not currently reject; the append_stopsign flush/set split is recovered by the normal AcceptSync path; and reordered or lost Decide/AcceptDecide messages are repaired by sequence-number detection and PrepareReq. No record changes are warranted, so the saved research state is retained unchanged.
